findings.title: Decrypt catch may swallow pre-decrypt CipherInitException
findings.description: Tech-spec step 3 narrows the catch to AEADBadTagException, IllegalArgumentException, and GeneralSecurityException. Spring Boot's TokenEncryptor commonly throws javax.crypto.NoSuchPaddingException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, or InvalidKeyException at first init (covered by GeneralSecurityException — good). However, BadPaddingException is the legacy non-AEAD form; modern AES-GCM in JDK 21 should throw AEADBadTagException, but JCE provider variants can still surface BadPaddingException directly. Both extend GeneralSecurityException, so the listed catch covers them. The remaining gap: javax.crypto.IllegalBlockSizeException is also GeneralSecurityException — covered. Net: the explicit list is technically complete, but the tech-spec should clarify that GeneralSecurityException is the umbrella covering BadPaddingException/IllegalBlockSizeException/InvalidKeyException, and that NullPointerException / IllegalStateException from a misconfigured TokenEncryptor bean MUST propagate (not be swallowed) so ops sees real config failures as 500 rather than misleading 422 invalid_bot_token.
findings.location: Section: Architecture > How it works > step 3 (line 56)
findings.impact: Negligible runtime risk — the listed exceptions cover all crypto failure modes. Documentation gap only: a future reader could re-broaden the catch to Exception, re-introducing the round-1 issue.
findings.recommendation: Add one sentence to step 3: 'Any other Throwable (NPE, IllegalStateException from misconfigured bean) must propagate to GlobalErrorHandler as 500 — do not classify config errors as invalid_bot_token.' Add a unit test in Task 4 stubbing TokenEncryptor to throw IllegalStateException and asserting the response is 500, not 422.

round2_fix_verification.A02_catch_scope: RESOLVED — line 56 now explicitly lists AEADBadTagException, IllegalArgumentException, GeneralSecurityException with 'scoped to the decrypt call only (not a blanket Exception around the whole chain)'. Catch is appropriately narrow. Minor doc clarification noted as new finding above.
round2_fix_verification.A02_plaintext_lifetime: RESOLVED — lines 67-68 explicitly document 'reachable until subscription completes — up to the 30s overall timeout in the worst case (large retry_after waits + transient retries)'. Honest disclosure aligned with the rejected-cache decision.
round2_fix_verification.A03_token_shape_ordering: RESOLVED — step 4 (line 57) now numbered BEFORE URI construction (step 6) with explicit non-negotiable ordering note: 'shape validation must precede the wire call to prevent a tampered-Mongo token from being concatenated into the WebClient URI template'.
round2_fix_verification.A04_test_message_rate_limit: RESOLVED — R11 (line 387) flags as out-of-scope with rationale (authenticated session, single-user manual click, bounded by Telegram's own response). Documented; not gated.
round2_fix_verification.A09_chatId_PII: RESOLVED — R12 (line 388) flags chatId/messageId as PII without retention policy, scoped as cross-cutting concern for future analytics/compliance epic.
round2_fix_verification.A09_system_context_attribution: RESOLVED — R8 (line 384) documented; explicitly defers to Epic 06/07 design.

new_concerns_scan.expanded_architecture: No new attack surfaces. The added Math.max(0, Math.min(retryAfter, 30)) clamp (line 64) correctly defends against negative-retry_after spin loops AND against pathological large values (caps single-delay at 30s while the outer 30s timeout caps total budget). No SSRF — base URL is configuration-controlled, only the token portion comes from decrypted-and-validated bot doc.
new_concerns_scan.new_test_scenarios: sendText_429NegativeRetryAfter_clampsToZero_thenCapsAtOverallTimeout (line 306) explicitly tests the spin-loop defense — strong. sendText_corruptedCiphertext_throwsBotTokenInvalidException_beforeHttp (line 316) verifies AEADBadTagException path. Token-leak tests split per log site (lines 325-329) provide thorough scrubber coverage including transport-error path that echoes URI.
new_concerns_scan.new_risks_R11_R12: Both appropriately scoped as out-of-scope with documented rationale. Acceptable risk acceptance posture — does not introduce vulnerability, only acknowledges existing platform conventions.
